reviews.reason: The style-only command catalogue filters a missing declaration for new-channel requests, then overlays persisted enabled flags and model availability on retained declarations. This deliberate two-stage fixture projection preserves declarations and source metadata; it is not production per-row I/O or a repeated whole-catalogue lookup for rendering. P21f reassessed 2026-11-17: Style command fixture replaces command_settings with canonical discriminated commands of kind registered; enabled lookup now checks that discriminator. It still filters the missing declaration only for new-channel views before overlaying persisted enabled/model availability. Communication binding assertions cover canonical registered/event payloads and readonly/save draft behavior; no production request-loop optimization is inferred.
